name: Malaysia Airlines MHexplorer student program
summary: Student program giving discounts and extra baggage on Malaysia Airlines and Firefly flights for students aged 13 to 26.
key: Fly more with savings up to 30% off Malaysia Airlines and Firefly flights.
how: Sign up at malaysiaairlines.com/MHexplorer and submit the required documents.
catches: If documents are not provided, expired or invalid, the normal fare applies.
An additional 10kg baggage is provided, subject to terms and conditions.

evidence.quote: Fly more with savings up to 30% off Malaysia Airlines and Firefly flights.
MHexplorer is open to all students aged 13-26 years old.
